# Quarrystone Brewing - brewhouse workspace

Shared folder for the brewing team.

- brew/  brew sheets for the week
- casks/  cask returns from the trade

turns.prompt: Quarrystone's cellarman asked what the Plato figure on a brew sheet means; it is the extract sugar written as grams per hundred grams of the mash. Tuesday's mash weighed 3,000 kilograms and read 12.4 Plato. Give the mass of extract in that mash, in kilograms. Reply with only the final answer. If you cannot determine the answer, reply exactly UNKNOWN.
